IS 5282 : 1969 Liquid Sedimentation Methods for Determination of Particle Size of PowdersUDC 620.168.336 : 621-492 : 66-492CED 55Reaffirmed 20201 Scope1.1 This standard covers three methods by liquid sedimentation for quantitative determination of particle size distribution in sub-sieve range. The first two methods are used for the particle size down to about 3Âµ while the third method is applicable to the determination of particle size distribution in the range 3 to 0.01 micron.2 ReferencesIS 4124 : 1967Glossary of terms relating to powdersIS 1448 :1960 Methods of test for petroleum and its productsIS 2720 : Part III : 1966 Methods of test for soils:Part III Determination of specific gravity
